_metadata.description: WCAG AA contrast checking for brand color pairings, dog-fooded by the scenario that validates contrast for others.

requirements.title: Compute WCAG contrast ratio for a color pairing
requirements.description: Given two colors the engine computes the WCAG relative-luminance contrast ratio and reports whether it meets the AA threshold (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text).

validation.notes: Planned unit coverage at api/internal/contrast/ratio_test.go once the contrast engine is ported.

requirements.title: Flag non-compliant brand color pairings
requirements.description: The defined brand pairings (primary-on-background, text-on-surface) are checked during generation and validation, and a pairing below AA is flagged/rejected with the failing pair and measured ratio.

validation.notes: Planned unit coverage at api/internal/contrast/pairings_test.go once pairing checks are ported.
